icons.name: NoSurvivors
icons.label: 无人生还
icons.subject: A decisive converging bombardment: three slim, sweeping projectile-energy paths curl from the upper left into ONE strong impact at lower right. The curves have different radii, lengths and widths, with a clear space between them. They are fast tapered strokes, not three identical solid bent tubes. Make the lower-right impact a compact three-dimensional jagged energy burst with a pale core and a deep purple outer silhouette, not a flat generic sticker star. Suggest a shallow impact crater using only a small broken elliptical rim and three angular rock fragments at its foot. The burst and converging motion form ONE compact visual emblem; no large ground platform. Keep the leading arc graceful, the other two subordinate, and the energy direction unambiguous.
icons.color: Dominant dark and middle violet: #2A104B and #522C5C occupy most colored area. #835061 supplies controlled mauve lit surfaces; #E3B6B1 is a narrow bright track and burst transition, with a tiny #FEE4D9 impact core. Contour #150017. These are muted plum-purple colors, not electric magenta or fluorescent violet.
icons.prompt:
Create one polished game ability icon for a mechanical science-fiction roguelike, as a transparent PNG. Match the clean illustrated cel-rendering and confident contours of reference images 2 and 3, while using ONLY the palette specified below. Reference image 1 provides the subject and action, not the finish.
Art direction: a mature, elegantly simplified mechanical-comic illustration. Give the subject convincing volume and perspective using precisely designed surfaces and three clearly separated cel-shading regions. Smooth solid component colors. A clear dark outer contour, thinner functional inner seams, and tapered lines on effects; keep outlines substantial enough for 64px but never a thick sticker rim. Use restrained bevel highlights and large intentional shadow shapes. Light from upper left. One dominant focal point; secondary shapes guide the eye toward it.
Design the silhouette deliberately: bold tapering shapes, rhythmic curves, thoughtful negative space and an asymmetric yet balanced composition. The primary form carries about two thirds of the visual weight; the motion effect supports it. Fit the complete design inside a square with around 8% transparent padding. A concise icon with a handful of meaningful forms, not a miniature scene. Keep it legible at 64px. No texture, mottling, scratches, micro-detail, text, labels, watermark, decorative badge, frame, scenery, fake checkerboard or background glow plate.
Produce a single finished icon, not a grid. Real transparent alpha, no cast shadow on a background.

icons.name: EnhancedBullet
icons.label: 强化子弹
icons.subject: A powerful armor-piercing energy bullet thrusting from lower right to upper left. Show a compact, beautifully tapered black mechanical projectile head at the upper-left third with a red tip and one red longitudinal inset. Its body must be recognizable, with a clear pointed nose, a collar and one hard beveled plane; no fins. A tiny sharp four-point compression flash touches the leading tip. Behind it, two clean red energy streaks create a narrowing diagonal wake toward lower right. The projectile head and its lit leading edge are the focal point, the long wake is secondary. The shapes express weight and speed together; the entire icon is broader and more balanced than a lone needle line.
icons.color: Black-red only: body #1A182F, deepest contour #150017; red body accent #8E3A2A, main energy #A34053, small highlight #EABCBA, tiny core #FEE4D9. Keep the bullet predominantly dark and the red wake rich and restrained, not pink candy or orange fire. Distinct three-level shading on the body.

icons.name: ExplosivePackage
icons.label: 爆破套餐
icons.subject: A formation of EXACTLY THREE finned sci-fi missiles executing one sweeping turn. Use a triangular staggered formation with a large leading missile near the right-middle, a second about 80% its apparent size above-left, and a third about 65% below-left. All fly in compatible directions toward upper right with believable three-quarter perspective; each remains clearly separate. Each missile needs only a pointed faceted nose, one smooth cylinder, one rear collar and crisp swept fins. Three tapered exhaust ribbons curve together from lower left and separate cleanly into the three rear nozzles, giving an elegant sweeping S-shaped motion through the icon. More visual weight in missiles, less in trails. Avoid three equal copies stacked in a column. No clouds or background.
icons.color: Dominant plum-purple hulls #522C5C, broad shadow facets #2A104B, small lit planes #835061. Sparse pale #E3B6B1 bevels and tiny #FEE4D9 exhaust tips. #150017 contour. Trails use shaded #522C5C and #835061 with a narrow pale center. Purple remains dominant; no neon purple or bright magenta and no orange flame.

icons.name: FireRate
icons.label: 增加攻速
icons.subject: A stylized fictional blue rotating multi-barrel sci-fi cannon, viewed three quarters with the muzzle toward upper right. It should have the visual credibility of a sleek game weapon icon: a tapered armored rear body at lower left, a clearly lengthwise barrel cluster, ONE simple clamp around the cluster, and a partially visible round side drum. The barrel assembly projects forward in coherent perspective and ends in six dark muzzle apertures distributed on ONE angled circular face, not four flat circles laid onto a rectangle. Emphasize the strong muzzle silhouette and connected barrel lengths rather than many mechanical details. One short blue firing accent plus two slim trailing rotation arcs convey rapid fire. The arcs support the barrel form and are less than one fifth of the composition. No functional schematic or internal construction detail; no tiny screws, hoses, or dense greebles.
icons.color: Dominant blue hull #6AA4BE with large #274E61 shadow facets and #1A182F contour/muzzle cavities. Small #0D9099 and #0A6F73 energy/rotation accents; narrow #FEE4D9 top-edge bevel highlight. Blue dominates; no green lighting, purple body or orange fire.

icons.name: ExplosiveEnhancement
icons.label: 强化爆炸弹
icons.subject: ONE enhanced explosive sci-fi rocket flying diagonally toward upper right in a confident three-quarter view. The rocket is the hero, roughly two thirds of the visual mass: a substantial faceted pointed warhead, smooth straight cylinder, one purposeful rear ring, and two or three sharp swept fins. The central axis is straight and coherent. Use a narrow lit band around the warhead base to identify enhanced payload, and a single broad highlight plane on the nose. A compact sharp exhaust flame leads into one shorter, elegantly curling S-shaped smoke ribbon toward lower left. No second rocket, extra explosion, large orbit ring or scenery.
icons.color: Main rocket #522C5C and #2A104B with controlled #835061 lit planes. Small #E3B6B1 nose bevel and payload band, a tiny #FEE4D9 exhaust core, #150017 contour. Smoke remains muted purple/mauve with three distinct values; it must not become a large pale pink shape that dominates the rocket. No electric purple, red nose or yellow flame.
